$why: Moved out of spec-mode-runner.js runSpecAgent on 2026-08-16.
The openspec agent writes the specification every later stage is judged against. Every
one of its seventeen inputs is a NAMED BLOCK computed above the literal — nothing branches
inside the prompt itself, which is why this one migrates cleanly where the VC prompts did
not: there is no conditional here for a fixture to leave unexercised.
Its seven ADJACENT blocks on the opening line are what exposed a greedy-matching bug in the
renderer: __A____B__ was read as one placeholder, so this template declared a token nobody
supplies and threw on every render. The pattern is lazy now; substitution by key was always
body:
__FORCED_RETRY_BLOCK__You are the __AGENT__ specification agent for EPAM CLI. Phase __PHASE__, story __STORY_ID__.__SPLIT_WARNING____PRIOR_GAPS_BLOCK____SEMBLE_CONTEXT____REFERENCED_DOCS_EVIDENCE____FIX_SITE_BLOCK____DECLARED_FILE_BLOCK____BROWNFIELD_ARCHAEOLOGY_BLOCK__
__GENERATE_INSTRUCTION__
{
  "storyId":"__STORY_ID__",
  "agent":"__AGENT__",
  "notes":"context",
  "acceptanceCriteria":["..."],
  "description":"...",
  "title":"...",__LOCATION_HINT_SCHEMA_LINE____SPLIT_SCHEMA_FIELD__
}
Use existing text when no change is needed.__SPLIT_RULES_BLOCK__

Story context:
__STORY_PAYLOAD____PUBLISHED_CONTRACTS__
